log_scope: Selected exact substantive queries; navigational retries and all search hits are not exhaustively enumerated
inclusion: Primary experiments, methods, author datasets and manufacturer specifications directly relevant to the design
exclusions: Commercial efficacy claims without usable methods; secondary summaries not used as decision-driving evidence
retrieval_limits: Some PubMed/PMC, publisher and institutional full-text requests were blocked. The source register distinguishes indexed abstracts/excerpts, full text and unverified leads. No failure was treated as evidence of absence.
